author: National Geographic
description:
Chris Hemsworth: A Road Trip to Remember is a deeply personal documentary. Following his father Craig’s recent Alzheimer’s disease diagnosis, Chris designs an emotional road trip across Australia. While revisiting key places from their past to spark Craig’s memories, they explore the groundbreaking science of social connection, brain health, and longevity. Discover how deep community bonds, love, and nostalgia can become a potent medicine to slow down cognitive decline and combat dementia.
